result.summary: The page is generally usable, but the promotional banner has severely washed-out/low-contrast text that makes the offer and code hard to read. Carousel truncation on the right appears intentional, while the banner contrast is the clearest visual defect.

issues.description: Promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3...') is white/light on a pale mint background with very low contrast, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text, increase overlay/background contrast, or use a bolder foreground color that meets WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The rightmost 'Fastest near you' card is clipped at the screen edge, showing a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...').
issues.suggestion: This is typical for horizontal scrolling, but add clearer scroll affordance or ensure text ellipsis does not hide essential names when partially visible.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off by the bottom navigation/viewport, which is expected while scrolling but makes the section feel abruptly cropped in a static view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding above the tab bar and consistent card spacing so partially visible content looks intentional.
